zoe: Heads-up 1 1 HelioChem submitted an onboarding for a 7B domain-tuned "chem-safety" model. They want Private deployment, customer-managed HSM, full safety evals, and logs exportable (redacted). Target go-live ~3 weeks. Uploaded intake + sample prompts.

sam: Thanks. Do they provide artifact format and expected QPS? Any latency SLOs?

zoe: Artifact is PyTorch (.pt) + tokenizer; they'd like int8 quant. QPS steady 8, burst 40. Target p50 <300ms for 512 tokens. Canary for 30 days with auto-rollback on safety/regression.

linda: Can we ask for a 200-example failure set and a 1k prompt safety suite? Also ask whether they need inference inside their VPC or our private VPC. HSM attestation required.

ops-bot: Intake created: HC-ONB-3026  assigned: cs-ops  priority: P2  ticket: CS-ONB-8001

zoe: Uploaded artifacts: gs://redwood-cs/heliochem/heliochem_eval_v1.csv and model pointer s3://heliochem/model.pt. Customer link: https://share.heliochem/chem-safety.

sam: I'll schedule a sync w/eng & privacy tomorrow 11am PT. @linda will you own the eval harness? Also need to confirm KMS onboarding steps.

linda: I'll take evals. Plan: run baseline vs redwood-7b and compute NER F1, hallucination delta, and PII leakage. Using harness: `./eval_runner --model s3://heliochem/model.pt --prompts gs://redwood-cs/heliochem/heliochem_eval_v1.csv --baseline redwood-7b --metrics ner_f1,hallucination,phi_leak,latency`

zoe: Procurement flagged renewal risk if p50 >350ms. Prioritize perf targets.

sam: If int8 fails SLOs we recommend dedicated capacity or 4-bit+kernel tuning. For rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks, auto-rollback on safety alerts.

linda: I'll request their failure set + PHI field list today. Expect first-pass evals in 48 hours. Will post results here.

zoe: Customer also asked for daily CSV of redacted inference traces. I'll confirm allowed fields and add to intake checklist.

sam: Great. We'll cover infra & evals in tomorrow sync and update this thread after.
